component-mapping:data-product-definitio.rationale: ODPS provides a machine-readable metadata model for describing a data product's business, technical and governance characteristics.
component-mapping:data-product-definitio.boundary: It describes the product; it does not build, publish or operate the product.

component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.rationale: ODCS defines a portable data contract covering schema, semantics, quality requirements, ownership and service expectations.
component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.boundary: The standard defines the contract; separate tooling is required to validate or enforce it at runtime.

component-mapping:semantic-description-o.rationale: Apache Ossie defines vendor-neutral semantic metadata for metrics, dimensions and relationships across analytics and AI platforms.
component-mapping:semantic-description-o.boundary: It supplies a semantic description and exchange format, not a complete semantic governance platform.

component-mapping:trigger-invocation-clo.rationale: CloudEvents standardises the event envelope used to communicate an event that can trigger pipeline work.
component-mapping:trigger-invocation-clo.boundary: It does not deliver the event or invoke the workload; a broker, endpoint or event runtime is still required.

component-mapping:workload-planning-airf.rationale: Airflow DAGs define task dependencies, schedules, retries and execution order for planned workloads.
component-mapping:workload-planning-airf.boundary: Planning is expressed as code and scheduling configuration; Airflow does not determine business priorities or capacity requirements automatically.

component-mapping:workload-planning-pref.rationale: Prefect flows and deployments define task dependencies, schedules and execution policy.
component-mapping:workload-planning-pref.boundary: Prefect plans executable workflow structure; business prioritisation and infrastructure capacity planning remain external concerns.

component-mapping:workload-planning-temp.rationale: Temporal Schedules can start Workflow Executions according to time-based specifications.
component-mapping:workload-planning-temp.boundary: Temporal is primarily a durable workflow execution platform rather than a general workload or capacity-planning system.

component-mapping:secure-read-access-opa.rationale: OPA can evaluate authorisation policy for a request to read a protected resource.
component-mapping:secure-read-access-opa.boundary: OPA is the policy decision point; the calling service, gateway or storage platform must enforce the decision.

component-mapping:source-connectivity-ad.rationale: ADBC provides a standard API for efficient, Arrow-native connectivity to database systems.
component-mapping:source-connectivity-ad.boundary: A compatible ADBC driver is required for each source system.

component-mapping:source-connectivity-jd.rationale: JDBC provides the standard Java API used to connect to and operate on relational data sources.
component-mapping:source-connectivity-jd.boundary: A source-specific JDBC driver and appropriate authentication configuration are still required.

component-mapping:source-connectivity-od.rationale: ODBC provides a language- and vendor-neutral interface for accessing database management systems.
component-mapping:source-connectivity-od.boundary: A compatible ODBC driver and source-specific configuration are still required.

component-mapping:source-connectivity-ht.rationale: HTTP provides the application protocol used to connect to API-based data sources.
component-mapping:source-connectivity-ht.boundary: HTTP does not define the source API, authentication scheme, payload format or data contract.

component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.rationale: Airflow schedules and executes dependency-ordered tasks while tracking task-instance state and retries.
component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.boundary: Task code and external side effects remain the responsibility of the pipeline implementation.

component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.rationale: Prefect executes flows and tasks with dependency tracking, states, retries and timeouts.
component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.boundary: The flow implementation must still provide the domain logic and control external side effects.

component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.rationale: Temporal provides durable workflow execution that resumes after process or infrastructure failure.
component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.boundary: Workflow and Activity code still provide the domain logic and integrations.

component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.rationale: dbt resolves and executes the dependency graph for data transformation models.
component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.boundary: This mapping is limited to transformation-graph execution; broader pipeline scheduling requires dbt jobs or an external orchestrator.

component-mapping:lineage-emission-openl.rationale: OpenLineage defines an interoperable job, run and dataset event model so pipelines can emit operational lineage during execution.
component-mapping:lineage-emission-openl.boundary: OpenLineage is the lineage event contract, not the orchestrator. Tools such as Airflow may emit OpenLineage events via a provider; that does not make Airflow itself OpenLineage.

component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.rationale: Airflow records task-instance state and supports controlled retries of failed tasks.
component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.boundary: Airflow expects task implementations to be idempotent; it does not make external actions idempotent automatically.

component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.rationale: Prefect persists run states and can use result caching to avoid repeating completed work.
component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.boundary: Result persistence must be configured, and task side effects still require idempotent design.

component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.rationale: Temporal durably records workflow history and replays deterministic workflow code to recover state.
component-mapping:state-and-idempotency-.boundary: Activities that change external systems must still be designed to tolerate retries and duplicate requests.

component-mapping:validation-and-contrac.rationale: ODCS supplies a machine-readable contract and validation constraints that tooling can bind to a pipeline interface.
component-mapping:validation-and-contrac.boundary: The ODCS specification does not itself perform runtime validation; an implementation such as Data Contract CLI is required.

component-mapping:validation-and-contrac.rationale: dbt data tests validate assertions about models and their data during transformation workflows.
component-mapping:validation-and-contrac.boundary: Data tests do not by themselves bind an external ODCS contract; model contracts or explicit translation are required for contract binding.

component-mapping:failure-isolation-airf.rationale: Airflow tracks failure and retry state independently at the task-instance boundary.
component-mapping:failure-isolation-airf.boundary: Isolation applies to orchestrated task execution; external side effects require their own transaction or compensation design.

component-mapping:failure-isolation-pref.rationale: Prefect can contain failures at task boundaries and apply task-specific retry and timeout policies.
component-mapping:failure-isolation-pref.boundary: Effective isolation depends on decomposing work into separate tasks and safely handling external side effects.

component-mapping:failure-isolation-temp.rationale: Temporal isolates failures at Workflow and Activity boundaries and provides configurable retries, timeouts and failure propagation.
component-mapping:failure-isolation-temp.boundary: External systems are outside Temporal's transaction boundary and may require compensation or idempotency controls.

component-mapping:secure-write-access-op.rationale: OPA can evaluate authorisation policy for a request to write to a protected resource.
component-mapping:secure-write-access-op.boundary: OPA is the policy decision point; the calling service, gateway or storage platform must enforce the decision.

component-mapping:metadata-registration-.rationale: The Iceberg REST Catalog API registers and manages Iceberg table metadata and catalog operations.
component-mapping:metadata-registration-.boundary: It is an Iceberg table catalog, not a general enterprise metadata catalogue or business glossary.

component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.rationale: Iceberg supplies a transactional open-table representation for the stored tabular output of a data product.
component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.boundary: It represents the table asset, not the complete data product, contract, ownership or operational controls.

component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.rationale: Delta Lake provides transactional table storage with schema enforcement and batch and streaming support.
component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.boundary: It implements the stored tabular asset rather than the complete data product and its governance metadata.

component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.rationale: Apache Hudi manages transactional tables and supports incremental and streaming-oriented writes.
component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.boundary: It implements the stored tabular asset rather than the complete data product and its governance metadata.

component-mapping:source-connectivity-ka.rationale: Apache Kafka provides a durable, partitioned log that pipelines can consume as an event source.
component-mapping:source-connectivity-ka.boundary: Kafka supplies transport and retention for events; schema contracts, exactly-once semantics and consumer application logic remain separate.

component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.rationale: Apache Spark executes distributed transformations and actions across a cluster as a processing workload.
component-mapping:workload-execution-orc.boundary: Spark runs jobs; upstream orchestration still schedules when those jobs should run and with which credentials.

component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.rationale: Apache Parquet is a columnar on-disk format commonly used for analytical outputs written by pipelines.
component-mapping:store-write-data-produ.boundary: Parquet encodes files; transactional table semantics require a table format such as Iceberg, Delta or Hudi when needed.

component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.rationale: JSON Schema expresses structural and constraint rules that a data contract can embed or reference.
component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.boundary: It defines validation rules; publishing, ownership and SLAs of the contract remain outside JSON Schema itself.

component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.rationale: OpenAPI describes HTTP APIs and payload schemas that can form the interface side of a data contract.
component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.boundary: OpenAPI documents an API surface; runtime enforcement and data-product metadata still need other artefacts.

component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.rationale: Apache Avro supplies a compact schema and serialization format suited to contract-bound record exchange.
component-mapping:data-contract-definiti.boundary: Avro covers schema and encoding; registry policy, compatibility rules and product ownership remain separate.
